title: Starship Reaches Orbit; Crew-13 Launch Marks Back-to-Back SpaceX Milestones
detail: SpaceX Starship achieved orbital insertion in a landmark test flight, marking the program's first confirmed orbital success. NASA's Crew-13 mission also featured prominently in space news, with the Dragon spacecraft delivering crew to the ISS. The two milestones represent a significant moment in SpaceX's manifest, validating both the next-generation heavy-lift vehicle and continuing crewed commercial spaceflight operations.

title: FAA Opens Public Comment Period on SpaceX Starship Florida Launch Plans
detail: The Federal Aviation Administration opened a public comment period on SpaceX's Starship launch plans from Florida, signalling regulatory progress toward establishing an East Coast launch site for the world's largest rocket. The move marks a significant step in the FAA environmental review process that would allow Starship operations from Kennedy Space Center or Cape Canaveral, complementing the existing Starbase facility in Boca Chica, Texas.
